lines.text: Remember making shadow animals on the wall as a kid? In Shadow Zoo, they come alive.

lines.at: Your hands cast shadows on your own wall
lines.text: Light the lantern, and your real hands cast shadows on your real wall.

lines.at: Make the shape it shows, and it comes alive
lines.text: A glowing outline appears. Shape your hand to match it, and the rabbit wriggles free!

lines.at: Feed it: a pinch releases a firefly
lines.text: Pinch to release a firefly, and watch it chase it down.

lines.at: Pet it: let your shadow rest on it
lines.text: Rest your shadow on it to pet it. Hearts grow, and friends learn tricks.

lines.at: Every visitor is a new shadow to learn
lines.text: Every visitor is a new shadow puppet to master. A dog. A crocodile.

lines.at: Wear a creature: snap its jaw and it speaks
lines.text: Make a shape you have already found, and you become it. Snap the dog's jaw, and it barks!

lines.at: Wear a creature: snap its jaw and it speaks
lines.text: Feed the whole zoo, and new visitors keep coming.

lines.at: Two hands make a bird, and it flies
lines.text: And then, the classic. Hook your thumbs, spread your fingers, and the bird takes wing!

lines.at: Find all seven, and your zoo is complete
lines.text: Find all seven creatures, and the whole zoo celebrates. Your lantern turns gold.

lines.at: Come back tomorrow: your zoo remembers you
lines.text: Come back tomorrow. Your zoo remembers you, and your streak keeps the lantern warm.
Every day brings a visitor with a twist. This big one needs your hand closer to the light.
Every day brings a visitor with a twist. This shy one needs you to hold perfectly still.

lines.at: Pet a friend with three hearts and it does a trick
lines.text: Pet a friend with three hearts, and it does a trick for you.

lines.at: A hands-only menu: point and pinch
lines.text: No controllers, ever. Even the menu is just point and pinch.
Shadow Zoo. Hand shadows that come alive, on your own wall. Play it free on Meta Quest.
